status: sizing only; part data is search-sourced, not datasheet-verified

requirements.note: capacitance and ESR are the values the 100 A model runs with; RMS is measured from the four SR currents

caveats: bank ESR = part ESR / N assumes zero interconnect resistance; at N>=15 the copper spreading resistance is not negligible and is not modelled here
0.2 mohm is the value the simulation ran with, not a specified limit; at 0.1 mohm the count doubles
part data is a vendor page summary; capacitance at 2 V bias, ESR at temperature and end of life are not included
